'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Metekel conflict]]
**[[Metekel massacre]]
***The [[Ethiopian National Defense Force]] clashes with armed [[bandit]]s involved in yesterday's [[massacre]], killing 42 of them and seizing weapons. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/world/2020/12/24/Ethiopian-troops-kill-42-armed-men-behind-deadly-village-attack-reports-state-TV (Al Arabiya English)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[Pemi attack]]
***[[Boko Haram]] [[jihadist]]s storm Pemi, a [[Christianity in Nigeria|Christian]] village in [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]], [[mass shooting|shooting]] people and [[arson|burning down]] a church and a hospital, killing at least 11 civilians. A priest is [[Kidnapping|kidnapped]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-55448105 (BBC News)]
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**[[Niger]] says seven [[Niger Armed Forces|troops]] and 11 [[Islamist]] [[militant]]s have been killed in clashes in [[Tillabéri Region|Tillabéri]], ahead of Sunday's [[2020 Nigerien general election|general election]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1782321/world (''Arab News'')]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[December 2020 Afghanistan attacks]]
***Gunmen on a motorbike shoot dead a [[women’s rights]] activist and her brother near their home in [[Kohistan]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/24/afghan-womens-rights-activist-shot-dead (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]], [[CARES Act]]
**[[Republican Party (United States)|Republicans]] in the [[United States House of Representatives|House]] block an attempt by [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrats]], empowered by a veto threat from [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] if not amended, to pass a [[United States dollar|$]]2,000 relief bill for [[Americans]]. However, [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|House Speaker]] [[Nancy Pelosi]] announces that the House will still hold a vote on the bill on Monday. [https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2020/12/24/house-votes-on-2000-stimulus-checks-after-trump-supports-them.html (CNBC)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/white-house/pelosi-says-house-vote-bigger-stimulus-payments-after-gop-blocks-n1252335 (NBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**At least 20 African [[immigration to Italy|migrants]] die when their boat sinks off the coast of [[Tunisia]] as they tried to cross the [[Mediterranean Sea]] to the [[List of islands of Italy|Italian island]] of [[Lampedusa]]. The [[coast guard]] confirmed they had rescued people and were searching for others who were on the boat, which was carrying a total of 45 people. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-tunisia/at-least-20-die-as-migrant-boat-sinks-off-tunisia-idUSKBN28Y0ZN?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****The [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] announces that American passengers traveling from the [[United Kingdom]] will be required to [[COVID-19 testing|test]] negative for [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] within 72 hours due to the emergence of a new variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]]. The order is expected to take effect on December 28. [https://www.marketwatch.com/story/u-s-to-require-all-air-passengers-arriving-from-u-k-to-test-negative-for-covid-19-11608872050 (MarketWatch)]
*****[[United Airlines]] and [[Delta Air Lines]] will require passengers from the [[United Kingdom]] to test negative for COVID-19 due to the emergence of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2. [https://www.reuters.com/article/businessNews/idUSKBN28Y1RK (Reuters)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****[[California]] surpasses two million cases of COVID-19, becoming the first U.S. state to do so. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/california-covid-2-million-cases-first-state/ (CBS News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Arkansas]]
*****[[Arkansas]] reports 3,204 new cases on [[Christmas Eve]], a new single-day record. [https://www.arkansasonline.com/news/2020/dec/24/arkansas-virus-cases-more-3200-new-record-increase/?latest (''Arkansas Democrat-Gazette'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[Mexico]] begins vaccinations with the [[Pfizer]]-[[BioNTech]] [[Tozinameran|vaccine]]. An intensive care unit nurse in [[Mexico City]] becomes the first person in the country to receive the vaccine. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/mexico-starts-giving-first-shots-of-pfizer-biontech-vaccine/2020/12/24/b7a4c04e-45f8-11eb-ac2a-3ac0f2b8ceeb_story.html?outputType=amp (''The Washington Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Ontario]] reports 2,447 cases on [[Christmas Eve]], a new single-day record. [https://www.chroniclejournal.com/life/health/quebec/ontario-hits-record-daily-high-of-new-covid-19-cases-with-2-447-infections/article_ab5d73c4-d392-5414-90a3-dfe36c0f887b.html (''The Chronicle-Journal'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Quebec]]
*****[[Quebec]] reports 2,349 cases over the past 24 hours, a new single-day record. [https://montrealgazette.com/news/local-news/another-record-high-quebec-reports-2349-new-covid-19-cases-46-deaths (''Montreal Gazette'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Tokyo]] reports a record 888 new cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the total number of confirmed cases in the prefecture to 54,018. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20201224_11/amp.html (NHK World)]
****Nationwide, a record 3,743 new cases are reported in [[Japan]] in the past 24 hours. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2020/12/24/national/tokyo-888-record-covid-19-cases/ (''The Japan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]], [[travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****[[China]] says it will suspend all direct flights to and from the [[United Kingdom]] indefinitely due to the new variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/covid-19-china-uk-suspend-direct-flights-new-strain-13837144 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
****[[Indonesia]] issues a ban on travellers from the United Kingdom and restricts entry to people from mainland [[Europe]] and [[Australia]] to prevent the spread of the new variant of SARS-CoV-2. COVID-19 Task Force Chief [[Doni Monardo]] says that these measures will remain in place until January 8. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-indonesia/indonesia-issues-uk-travel-ban-over-coronavirus-variant-idUKKBN28Y11C?il=0 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****[[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] and the [[Ministry of Health (Israel)|Health Ministry]] announce that a third nationwide [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdown|lockdown]] will begin from December 27 at 5:00 p.m. local time for at least two weeks in order to curb the resurgence of COVID-19. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-set-to-enter-3rd-national-lockdown-on-sunday-as-infections-surge/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] surpasses 100,000 cases of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/covid-19-malaysia-cross-100k-mark-new-cases-13837912 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] reports the first case of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 from the United Kingdom after a woman who flew from [[London]] to [[Frankfurt]] this weekend tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.dw.com/en/new-covid-variant-reaches-germany-from-uk/a-56054140 (DW)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] surpasses two million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.ansa.it/english/news/general_news/2020/12/24/covid-19-italy-passes-two-million-cases-mark_e423bb32-15c9-439c-abc1-f8e3de23293d.html (ANSA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record 29,935 new cases and 635 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|deaths]] in the past 24 hours, thus bringing the nationwide totals to 2,963,688 confirmed cases and 53,096 deaths. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1782226/world (''Arab News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Serbia]], COVID-19 vaccine
****[[Serbia]] officially begins its [[vaccination]] programme against COVID-19, with [[Prime Minister of Serbia|Prime Minister]] [[Ana Brnabić]] becoming the first person to receive the [[Pfizer]]-[[BioNTech]] [[Tozinameran|vaccine]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/serbian-premier-europes-1st-to-get-covid-19-vaccine/2087668 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]], COVID-19 vaccine
****[[Turkey]] announces that [[CoronaVac]] is 91.25% effective in preventing COVID-19 based on data in interim studies. These initial results follow Phase III trials that involved 7,371 volunteers. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/1st-shipment-of-chinese-covid-19-vaccines-to-arrive-in-turkey-on-monday/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] surpasses one million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.kyivpost.com/ukraine-politics/covid-19-in-ukraine-11490-new-cases-223-new-deaths-352302-active-cases.html (''Kyiv Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]], COVID-19 vaccine
****Over 300,000 doses of [[Russia]]'s [[Gam-COVID-Vac|Sputnik V]] vaccine arrive in [[Argentina]]. [https://www.livemint.com/news/world/first-300-000-doses-of-sputnik-v-vaccine-arrive-in-argentina-to-fight-covid-19-11608826705190.html (Livemint)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile]], COVID-19 vaccine
****[[Chile]] begins its [[vaccination]] campaign against COVID-19 after the arrival of 10,000 doses of [[Pfizer]]-[[BioNTech]] [[Tozinameran|vaccine]] to the country. [https://www.plenglish.com/index.php?o=rn&id=63006&SEO=vaccination-campaign-against-covid-19-begins-in-chile (Prensa Latina)]

'''International relations'''
*[[European Union–United Kingdom relations]], [[Trade negotiation between the UK and the EU]]
**The United Kingdom and the [[European Union]] agree on a post-[[Brexit]] trade deal. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-55435930 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*In [[Pakistan]], the [[Sindh High Court]] orders the release of [[Ahmed Omar Saeed Sheikh]], initially [[capital punishment in Pakistan|sentenced to death]] for the [[kidnapping]] and [[murder]] of [[Americans|American]] journalist [[Daniel Pearl]] in [[Karachi]] in 2002. The [[government of Pakistan|government]] opposes his release on the basis of public safety; both the government and Pearl's family will appeal the decision. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/24/court-orders-release-of-man-charged-in-daniel-pearl-killing (Al Jazeera)]
*A 37-year-old man is [[criminal charge|charged]] with [[murder (United States law)|murder]] and [[hate crime]]s in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]], U.S., after killing a 82-year-old man in a hospital room for praying. Both men were in the hospital after testing positive for COVID-19. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-55408492 (BBC News)]
*The [[President of Burundi]], [[Évariste Ndayishimiye]], pardons four journalists jailed since 2019 for offences related to "undermining state security" following a petition by human rights groups and the journalists themselves. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-burundi-media/four-jailed-burundian-journalists-pardoned-by-president-idUSKBN28Y1RZ?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2020 Moldovan presidential election]]
**[[Maia Sandu]] is sworn in as the first female [[President of Moldova]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/moldova-sandu-president-inauguration/31017691.html (Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty)]
